# Veritya Daily

> Independent reporting on AI, cryptocurrency, finance, cybersecurity, and technology. Original analysis you can trust — not financial advice.

Veritya Daily is an independent news publication covering AI, cryptocurrency, finance, cybersecurity, and technology. 300+ original articles: breaking news, evergreen guides, scam protection, and product comparisons.

## Categories

- [AI News & Analysis](https://verityadaily.com/category-ai): Latest AI news, analysis, and guides — covering OpenAI, Anthropic, image generators, free AI tools, and what matters in artificial intelligence today.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://verityadaily.com/category-crypto): Cryptocurrency news and analysis — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, ETFs, airdrops, gas fees, and market-moving events. Original reporting, not financial advice.
- [Cybersecurity](https://verityadaily.com/category-cybersecurity): Cybersecurity news and guides — data breaches, phishing, password managers, VPNs, and practical tips to stay safe online. Original reporting you can trust.
- [Finance & Markets](https://verityadaily.com/category-finance): Finance and markets coverage — earnings, Fed decisions, IPOs, investing guides, and what moves markets. Original analysis, not financial advice.
- [Technology](https://verityadaily.com/category-technology): Technology news and reviews — smartphones, laptops, operating systems, and gadgets. iPhone, Samsung, Windows, and more. Original reporting you can trust.
- [Trending Stories](https://verityadaily.com/category-trending): Today's top trending stories in tech, crypto, and finance — the biggest headlines, viral moments, and market movers all in one place.
